title: FemTheme Duo #033 · 여 커브드 바스트·하와이안훌라·마녀 테마 / 여 브라질리언 부티 글램·텔레노벨라글램·간호사 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the carved stone galleries of Angkor Wat with sunlit sandstone paving, standard-height doorways and low stone steps, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Hawaiian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a natural glowing complexion, a flower tucked behind one ear, warm golden-tan skin, soft pastel-pink hair styled in a sleek wet-look slicked straight back, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long silver chain ending in one large faceted topaz drop, and on the other ear a large platinum hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a gold round bell, a tin ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten platinum bracelets. Extremely long almond nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous, a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below, but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a tall pointed black witch hat with a deep purple band and a thin purple ribbon choker, a deep purple silk scarf folded into the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust and knotted in a small knot at the side of her bust right beside one breast, one end of the silk trailing long down her side and the other end cut short, fully opaque and covering only what it must, and a minimal deep purple silk micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
LEFT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme black plain stiletto pumps with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Latina woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm golden-bronze skin, a sharp black winged liner, warm terracotta eyeshadow, heavy lashes, strong sculpted contour, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep berry lip, a fiery, passionate expression, soft pastel-pink hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large copper hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a lead hammer head, a silver miniature anvil), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large brass hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a copper barrel-shaped weight, an iron hammer head, a tin miniature anvil, a gold small flared temple bell, a gold teardrop-shaped sinker), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three gold rings. Extremely long round nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her hips and rear so wide; a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist sits above hips and a rear so massively rounded and projecting that they dominate her entire silhouette from every angle, the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape; a full round bust above the cinched waist, gigantic thick thighs meeting the rear's curve, thick soft arms; her head looks small on top of her body; not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a white nurse cap with a small red cross and a stethoscope draped around her neck, a tiny white glossy vinyl micro-bikini top of two small opaque triangle cups on thin strings tied at the neck and back, fully covering her bust, and a minimal white glossy vinyl micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
RIGHT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme white platform stiletto slingbacks, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
